subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot merge markdown chunks that fit within the existing 3600-byte safe limit, or should every structurally split markdown chunk remain a separate QQ message by design?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the desired user-visible contract depends on QQ platform limits and maintainer policy rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Land bounded safe-size merging
options.body: Accept the direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99032, merging only chunks that fit the existing safe limit while preserving split delivery for overflow.

options.title: Keep deliberate splitting
options.body: Treat the current multi-message behavior as the QQBot contract for markdown safety, then close this issue and related merging PRs with the platform-limit rationale.

options.title: Compare the two open PRs first
options.body: Pause both open chunk-merging PRs until maintainers choose whether the merge belongs at the send boundary or inside the markdown chunker.

recommendation.title: Land bounded safe-size merging
recommendation.body: Accept the direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99032, merging only chunks that fit the existing safe limit while preserving split delivery for overflow.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp authored the relevant QQBot chunker work and has already stated the platform-limit rationale in the issue discussion.
